name: JS Cursor Agent
description: Cursor CLI ACP runtime backend with long-lived process pooling.

command.label: Cursor CLI Command
command.help: Path to the Cursor agent CLI (for example: agent, agent.cmd, or /usr/local/bin/agent). Leave unset to use the default 'agent' command.

apiKey.label: API Key
apiKey.help: Cursor API key for authentication. Alternatively set CURSOR_API_KEY env var.

authToken.label: Auth Token
authToken.help: Cursor auth token. Alternatively set CURSOR_AUTH_TOKEN env var.

endpoint.label: Endpoint
endpoint.help: Custom Cursor API endpoint URL. Alternatively set CURSOR_ENDPOINT env var.

defaultMode.label: Default Session Mode
defaultMode.help: Initial session mode for new ACP sessions (agent / plan / ask).

permissionMode.label: Permission Mode
permissionMode.help: Auto-permission policy for non-interactive ACP sessions: approve-all, approve-reads, or deny-all.
